title: Self-Esteem Test
description: Find out how healthy your self-worth and self-compassion are.

questions.se_1: On the whole, I am very satisfied with myself.
questions.se_2: At times I truly think I am no good at all.
questions.se_3: I feel that I have a number of good qualities (skills or traits).
questions.se_4: I am able to do things as well as most other people.
questions.se_5: I feel I do not have much to be proud of in my life.
questions.se_6: I take a very positive attitude toward my future and myself.
questions.se_7: All in all, I am inclined to feel that I am a failure.
questions.se_8: I really wish I could have more respect for myself.
questions.se_9: In general, I feel that I'm a person of worth, at least on an equal level with others.
questions.se_10: These days, I often feel useless, stupid, or embarrassing.
questions.se_11: When I'm going through emotional difficulty, I try to be gentle and patient with myself.
questions.se_12: When I notice flaws in myself, I tend to punish and berate myself harshly.
questions.se_13: When things don't go as planned, I try to see it as something normal that everyone goes through.
questions.se_14: When I fail at something important, I feel as if I'm the worst person in the world.
questions.se_15: I try to be understanding toward the parts of myself I don't like.
questions.se_16: When I'm very sad, I get fixated on how much I'm suffering.
questions.se_17: I keep a healthy balance of mind even when something bad happens to me.
questions.se_18: I'm very intolerant (harsh) and judgmental about my own flaws and weaknesses.
questions.se_19: I give myself the care and tenderness I'd give a close friend who is sad.
questions.se_20: I feel personally defective when others can see my weaknesses.

results.description: You see yourself very harshly and feel unworthy. It's time to learn to love yourself.
Mostly positive, but your self-belief is easily shaken by failure or criticism.
You recognize your full worth as a person, whether you succeed or fail.
